v.t: Ha, Meem
v.l: Ha-Mim

v.t: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise
v.l: Tanzilu Al-Kitabi Mina Allahi Al-`Azizi Al-Hakimi

v.t: In the heavens and the earth are proofs for the believers
v.l: Inna Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi La'ayatin Lilmu'uminina

v.t: And in your own creation, and in the creatures He scattered, are signs for people of firm faith
v.l: Wa Fi Khalqikum Wa Ma Yabuththu Min Dabbatin 'Ayatun Liqawmin Yuqinuna

v.t: And in the alternation of night and day, and in the sustenance God sends down from the sky, with which He revives the earth after its death, and in the circulation of the winds, are marvels for people who reason
v.l: Wa Akhtilafi Al-Layli Wa An-Nahari Wa Ma 'Anzala Allahu Mina As-Sama'i Min Rizqin Fa'ahya Bihi Al-'Arđa Ba`da Mawtiha Wa Tasrifi Ar-Riyahi 'Ayatun Liqawmin Ya`qiluna

v.t: These are God’s Verses which We recite to you in truth. In which message, after God and His revelations, will they believe
v.l: Tilka 'Ayatu Allahi Natluha `Alayka Bil-Haqqi Fabi'ayyi Hadithin Ba`da Allahi Wa 'Ayatihi Yu'uminuna

v.t: Woe to every sinful liar
v.l: Waylun Likulli 'Affakin 'Athimin

v.t: Who hears God's revelations being recited to him, yet he persists arrogantly, as though he did not hear them. Announce to him a painful punishment
v.l: Yasma`u 'Ayati Allahi Tutla `Alayhi Thumma Yusirru Mustakbiraan Ka'an Lam Yasma`ha Fabashirhu Bi`adhabin 'Alimin

v.t: And when he learns something of Our revelations, he takes them in mockery. For such there is a shameful punishment
v.l: Wa 'Idha `Alima Min 'Ayatina Shay'aan Attakhadhaha Huzuan 'Ula'ika Lahum `Adhabun Muhinun

v.t: Beyond them lies Hell. What they have earned will not benefit them at all, nor will those they adopted as lords instead of God. They will have a terrible punishment
v.l: Min Wara'ihim Jahannamu Wa La Yughni `Anhum Ma Kasabu Shay'aan Wa La Ma Attakhadhu Min Duni Allahi 'Awliya'a Wa Lahum `Adhabun `Azimun

v.t: This is guidance. Those who blaspheme their Lord’s revelations will have a punishment of agonizing pain
v.l: Hadha Hudaan Wa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Bi'ayati Rabbihim Lahum `Adhabun Min Rijzin 'Alimun

v.t: It is God who placed the sea at your service, so that ships may run through it by His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, and that you may give thanks
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Sakhkhara Lakumu Al-Bahra Litajriya Al-Fulku Fihi Bi'amrihi Wa Litabtaghu Min Fađlihi Wa La`allakum Tashkuruna

v.t: And He placed at your service whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth—all is from Him. In that are signs for a people who think
v.l: Wa Sakhkhara Lakum Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Jami`aan Minhu 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Yatafakkaruna

v.t: Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not hope for the Days of God. He will fully recompense people for whatever they have earned
v.l: Qul Lilladhina 'Amanu Yaghfiru Lilladhina La Yarjuna 'Ayyama Allahi Liyajziya Qawmaan Bima Kanu Yaksibuna

v.t: Whoever does a good deed, it is for his soul; and whoever commits evil, it is against it; then to your Lord you will be returned
v.l: Man `Amila Salihaan Falinafsihi Wa Man 'Asa'a Fa`alayha Thumma 'Ila Rabbikum Turja`una
w: then it is for his soul

v.t: We gave the Children of Israel the Book, and wisdom, and prophecy; and We provided them with the good things; and We gave them advantage over all other people
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Bani 'Isra'ila Al-Kitaba Wa Al-Hukma Wa An-Nubuwata Wa Razaqnahum Mina At-Tayyibati Wa Fađđalnahum `Ala Al-`Alamina

v.t: And We gave them precise rulings. They fell into dispute only after knowledge came to them, out of mutual rivalry. Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding the things they differed about
v.l: Wa 'Ataynahum Bayyinatin Mina Al-'Amri Fama Akhtalafu 'Illa Min Ba`di Ma Ja'ahumu Al-`Ilmu Baghyaan Baynahum 'Inna Rabbaka Yaqđi Baynahum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Fima Kanu Fihi Yakhtalifuna

v.t: Then We set you upon a pathway of faith, so follow it, and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know
v.l: Thumma Ja`alnaka `Ala Shari`atin Mina Al-'Amri Fa Attabi`ha Wa La Tattabi` 'Ahwa'a Al-Ladhina La Ya`lamuna

v.t: They will not help you against God in any way. The wrongdoers are allies of one another, while God is the Protector of the righteous
v.l: Innahum Lan Yughnu `Anka Mina Allahi Shay'aan Wa 'Inna Az-Zalimina Ba`đuhum 'Awliya'u Ba`đin Wa Allahu Wa Liyu Al-Muttaqina

v.t: This is an illumination for mankind, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe with certainty
v.l: Hadha Basa'iru Lilnnasi Wa Hudaan Wa Rahmatun Liqawmin Yuqinuna

v.t: Do those who perpetrate the evil deeds assume that We will regard them as equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds, whether in their life or their death? Evil is their judgment
v.l: Am Hasiba Al-Ladhina Ajtarahu As-Sayyi'ati 'An Naj`alahum Kalladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Sawa'an Mahyahum Wa Mamatuhum Sa'a Ma Yahkumuna

v.t: God created the heavens and the earth with justice, so that every soul will be repaid for what it has earned. And they will not be wronged
v.l: Wa Khalaqa Allahu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Bil-Haqqi Wa Litujza Kullu Nafsin Bima Kasabat Wa Hum La Yuzlamuna

v.t: Have you considered him who has taken his desire for his god? God has knowingly led him astray, and has sealed his hearing and his heart, and has placed a veil over his vision. Who will guide him after God? Will you not reflect
v.l: Afara'ayta Mani Attakhadha 'Ilahahu Hawahu Wa 'Ađallahu Allahu `Ala `Ilmin Wa Khatama `Ala Sam`ihi Wa Qalbihi Wa Ja`ala `Ala Basarihi Ghishawatan Faman Yahdihi Min Ba`di Allahi 'Afala Tadhakkaruna
w: and Allah lets him go astray
and Allah lets him go astray

v.t: And they say, “There is nothing but this our present life; we die and we live, and nothing destroys us except time.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are only guessing
v.l: Wa Qalu Ma Hiya 'Illa Hayatuna Ad-Dunya Namutu Wa Nahya Wa Ma Yuhlikuna 'Illa Ad-Dahru Wa Ma Lahum Bidhalika Min `Ilmin 'In Hum 'Illa Yazunnuna

v.t: When Our clarifying Verses are recited to them, their only argument is to say, “Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Tutla `Alayhim 'Ayatuna Bayyinatin Ma Kana Hujjatahum 'Illa 'An Qalu A'tu Bi'aba'ina 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: Say, “God gives you life, then He makes you die; then He gathers you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”
v.l: Quli Allahu Yuhyikum Thumma Yumitukum Thumma Yajma`ukum 'Ila Yawmi Al-Qiyamati La Rayba Fihi Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: To God belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth. On the Day when the Hour takes place, on that Day the falsifiers will lose
v.l: Wa Lillahi Mulku As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Yawma Taqumu As-Sa`atu Yawma'idhin Yakhsaru Al-Mubtiluna

v.t: You will see every community on its knees; every community will be called to its Book: “Today you are being repaid for what you used to do
v.l: Wa Tara Kulla 'Ummatin Jathiyatan Kullu 'Ummatin Tud`a 'Ila Kitabiha Al-Yawma Tujzawna Ma Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: This Book of Ours speaks about you in truth. We have been transcribing what you have been doing.”
v.l: Hadha Kitabuna Yantiqu `Alaykum Bil-Haqqi 'Inna Kunna Nastansikhu Ma Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is the clear triumph
v.l: Fa'amma Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Fayudkhiluhum Rabbuhum Fi Rahmatihi Dhalika Huwa Al-Fawzu Al-Mubinu

v.t: But as for those who disbelieved: “Were My revelations not recited to you? But you turned arrogant, and were guilty people.”
v.l: Wa 'Amma Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'Afalam Takun 'Ayati Tutla `Alaykum Fastakbartum Wa Kuntum Qawmaan Mujrimina

v.t: And when it was said, “The promise of God is true, and of the Hour there is no doubt,” you said, “We do not know what the Hour is; we think it is only speculation; we are not convinced.”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qila 'Inna Wa`da Allahi Haqqun Wa As-Sa`atu La Rayba Fiha Qultum Ma Nadri Ma As-Sa`atu 'In Nazunnu 'Illa Zannaan Wa Ma Nahnu Bimustayqinina

v.t: The evils of what they did will become evident to them, and the very thing they ridiculed will haunt them
v.l: Wa Bada Lahum Sayyi'atu Ma `Amilu Wa Haqa Bihim Ma Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'un

v.t: And it will be said, “Today We forget you, as you forgot the encounter of this Day of yours. Your abode is the Fire, and there are no saviors for you
v.l: Wa Qila Al-Yawma Nansakum Kama Nasitum Liqa'a Yawmikum Hadha Wa Ma'wakumu An-Naru Wa Ma Lakum Min Nasirina

v.t: That is because you took God’s revelations for a joke, and the worldly life lured you.” So today they will not be brought out of it, and they will not be allowed to repent
v.l: Dhalikum Bi'annakum Attakhadhtum 'Ayati Allahi Huzuan Wa Gharratkumu Al-Hayaatu Ad-Dunya Falyawma La Yukhrajuna Minha Wa La Hum Yusta`tabuna

v.t: Praise belongs to God; Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, Lord of humanity
v.l: Falillahi Al-Hamdu Rabbi As-Samawati Wa Rabbi Al-'Arđi Rabbi Al-`Alamina

v.t: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth. He is the Majestic, the Wise
v.l: Wa Lahu Al-Kibriya'u Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu
